description: Two independent one-bit stages: on each step a stage passes the bit it was holding to its output and reads a new bit from its input, and either stage can capture a bit and play it back later

params.text: Copies the bit that stage is holding into its store when pressed, replacing what was there
Arms the stored bit when pressed, so the next step loads that bit instead of reading the input; it happens once and the input is read again after

inputs.text: The signal that stage reads as a bit on each step, anything above 0V counted as a one
Moves that stage on by one bit on each rising edge above 1V: the held bit goes to the output and the input is read into the hold
Copies the bit that stage is holding into its store on a rising edge; any voltage away from zero counts as high
Arms the stored bit on a rising edge, so the next step loads that bit instead of reading the input, once; any voltage away from zero counts as high

outputs.text: The bit that stage was holding before the last step, 10V for a one and 0V for a zero
10V whenever the voltage at that stage's step input is away from zero, for passing the step on to the next stage
10V while the bit that stage is holding is a one and 0V while it is a zero, which is what the lamp shows as well

notes: the two halves are not joined inside the module; to build a shift register patch one stage's output into the next stage's input and its step output into the next stage's step input
nothing moves until a clock is patched to a step input, and until then every output holds the value it already had
